cards.name: Hisuian Voltorb
cards.description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

cards.name: Hisuian Electrode
cards.description: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.description: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

cards.name: Combee
cards.description: The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.description: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.description: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.description: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

cards.name: Hisuian Lilligant
cards.description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.description: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.description: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.description: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.description: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

cards.name: Radiant Heatran
cards.description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.description: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.description: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.description: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.description: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.description: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.description: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

cards.name: Regice
cards.description: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.description: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.description: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name "scalchop.".

cards.name: Dewott
cards.description: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculin
cards.description: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculegion
cards.description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

cards.name: Radiant Greninja
cards.description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

cards.name: Bergmite
cards.description: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

cards.name: Hisuian Avalugg
cards.description: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

cards.name: Regieleki
cards.description: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

cards.name: Hisuian Typhlosion
cards.description: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.description: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.description: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.description: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.description: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.description: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.description: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.description: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

cards.name: Wyrdeer
cards.description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

cards.name: Hisuian Growlithe
cards.description: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

cards.name: Hisuian Arcanine
cards.description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.description: Every bit of Regirock's body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what's been lost.

cards.name: Cranidos
cards.description: Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.

cards.name: Rampardos
cards.description: This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully. Its brain was really small, so some theories suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.description: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.description: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

cards.name: Radiant Hawlucha
cards.description: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

cards.name: Hisuian Decidueye
cards.description: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

cards.name: Kleavor
cards.description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

cards.name: Kleavor
cards.description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

cards.name: Hisuian Qwilfish
cards.description: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

cards.name: Hisuian Qwilfish
cards.description: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

cards.name: Hisuian Overqwil
cards.description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

cards.name: Hisuian Overqwil
cards.description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

cards.name: Hisuian Sneasel
cards.description: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

cards.name: Hisuian Sneasler
cards.description: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.description: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

cards.name: Absol
cards.description: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

cards.name: Hisuian Samurott
cards.description: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.description: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

cards.name: Registeel
cards.description: Registeel's body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.

cards.name: Shieldon
cards.description: Although its fossils can be found in layers of primeval rock, nothing but its face has ever been discovered.

cards.name: Bastiodon
cards.description: This Pokémon is from roughly 100 million years ago. Its terrifyingly tough face is harder than steel.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

cards.name: Regidrago
cards.description: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.description: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.description: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

cards.name: Ursaluna
cards.description: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.description: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.description: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.description: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.description: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.description: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.description: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

cards.name: Hisuian Braviary
cards.description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
